exact_definition: MMGA implementation combines Latin Hypercube Sampling, ANN meta-model of a reduced-order ECAT-inspired simulator, and GA-style multi-objective refinement against voltage, temperature, and capacity features.
assumptions: No full P2D/ECAT simulator was provided; voltage/thermal/aging equations are reduced-order proxies.
CS2_36 lacks measured temperature, so a pseudo thermal observable is derived from current and internal resistance for primary training.
A single global parameter vector cannot simultaneously encode different cell formats/capacities; external validations are therefore shape-transfer tests.
invariants: Train ANN surrogate instead of repeatedly evaluating physical equations during GA
deviations: Reduced-order simulator replaces full ECAT/P2D PDE model.
GA uses ANN feature predictions rather than high-cost simulator calls.
